gates.name: identity_and_assay_harmonization
gates.purpose: Blocks name-only identity, unresolved isomers, unsafe pooling, cross-study batch correction, and irreversible imputation.

gates.name: provenance_and_multi_repository_safety
gates.purpose: Retains one-to-many repository records and prevents duplicate normalized keys from silently overwriting evidence.

gates.name: statistical_and_review_safety
gates.purpose: Keeps uncertain mappings or annotations review-gated and validates effect-search multiplicity semantics.

gates.name: motrpac_style_plotting
gates.purpose: Validates contrast/FDR semantics, mapping and coverage gates, hierarchy views, deterministic exports, and optional renderers.

gates.name: skill_and_agent_contracts
gates.purpose: Checks paired Codex/Claude skill contracts, implementation links, and agent review boundaries.

gates.name: benchmark_integrity_and_reproducibility
gates.purpose: Validates explicit benchmark denominators, disagreement accounting, provenance, and byte-reproducible pilot outputs.

gates.name: domain_review_contract_safety
gates.purpose: Validates advisory-only domain review packets, complete evidence-state coverage, and non-executable review boundaries.

gates.name: scientific_readiness_gate_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates required-module collection, import-error attribution, and unique gate ownership.

gates.name: network_boundary_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates that only allowlisted live-ingestion modules import a network client, that offline pilot modules stay offline, and that the documented allowlist matches the enforced one.

limitations: Passing does not validate performance on independent real studies, assay platforms, species, or cohorts.
Database routing tests do not execute optional or planned external connectors.
Hierarchy plots are descriptive; dedicated pathway enrichment and cross-platform meta-analysis models remain separate work.
Skill contract scores measure structure and linkage, not empirical scientific validity.
validation_scope: offline synthetic and deterministic repository regression tests
